ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CurrencyConversionAdministration_GLD
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration AS
(
	SELECT
		BGR.RTLIST_DATE AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
		,NULL AS CurrencyConversionId
		,BGR.FXD_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
		,BGR.VAR_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
		,BGR.RATECODE AS RateId
		,BGR.RCRE_USER_ID AS EmployeeId
		,NULL AS AdministrationTypeId
		,BGR.RCRE_TIME AS AdministrationTimestamp
		,'GLD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BGR.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BGR.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE_DELTA BGRD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE BGR
		ON BGRD.RTLIST_DATE = BGR.RTLIST_DATE 
		AND BGRD.RTLIST_NUM = BGR.RTLIST_NUM 
		AND BGRD.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = BGR.FXD_CRNCY_CODE 
		AND BGRD.VAR_CRNCY_CODE = BGR.VAR_CRNCY_CODE 
		AND BGRD.RATECODE = BGR.RATECODE 
		AND BGRD.BANK_ID = BGR.BANK_ID
		AND BGR.isLatest = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CurrencyConversionTimestamp
			,CurrencyConversionId
			,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
			,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
			,RateId
			,EmployeeId
			,AdministrationTypeId
			,AdministrationTimestamp)) AS HASHROW
			,CurrencyConversionTimestamp ,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId ,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

), 

TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CurrencyConversionTimestamp
			,CurrencyConversionId
			,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
			,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
			,RateId
			,EmployeeId
			,AdministrationTypeId
			,AdministrationTimestamp)) AS HASHROW
			,CurrencyConversionTimestamp ,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId ,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
	FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversionAdministration
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'GLD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp,TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp) AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId) AS ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId) AS ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_SRC SRC
	JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
		AND SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
		AND SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET 
	CurrencyConversionTimestamp = SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,CurrencyConversionId = SRC.CurrencyConversionId
	,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
	,RateId = SRC.RateId
	,EmployeeId = SRC.EmployeeId
	,AdministrationTypeId = SRC.AdministrationTypeId
	,AdministrationTimestamp = SRC.AdministrationTimestamp
	,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversionAdministration TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	AND DELTA.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
	AND DELTA.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration SRC
	ON SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	AND SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
	AND SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId ;

INSERT INTO BNKM.CurrencyConversionAdministration
	(CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,CurrencyConversionId
	,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
	,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
	,RateId
	,EmployeeId
	,AdministrationTypeId
	,AdministrationTimestamp
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT 
	CurrencyConversionTimestamp
	,CurrencyConversionId
	,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
	,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
	,RateId
	,EmployeeId
	,AdministrationTypeId
	,AdministrationTimestamp
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA;

END
